response:
That sounds like a genuinely stressful situation, especially when political views you never intended to make public are affecting both your workplace relationships and your client caseload. It's completely valid to feel unsettled by that.

If you can tolerate the current environment and genuinely believe tensions will ease after the election cycle, waiting it out is a reasonable option. However, if the hostility is affecting your well-being, professional confidence, or ability to serve clients effectively, it may be worth exploring other opportunities now rather than waiting. You don't have to decide immediately—consider quietly researching roles in other areas or practices so you have options regardless of how things unfold. Trust your read of the situation and give yourself permission to prioritize a workplace where you feel respected.
